purpose: Teach: プロテスタント/永住/聖人/女系/震度/上半身/巨匠/社団

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、プロテスタント系患者の医療配慮を医療チームで意識します
lines.en: Ren, we make sure our medical team is mindful of religious considerations for Protestant patients.
lines.style: Even, clear delivery. Medical professional speaking with measured confidence. No rush. Eye contact steady. Warm but professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、永住外国人の医療通訳を医療チームで手配します
lines.en: Yes — we'll arrange medical interpretation for permanent foreign residents with our team.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight nod quality to the opening. Calm, thorough. Speaking from practiced competence, not reassurance. Clinical precision with quiet humanity underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、聖人を信じる患者を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, we respect patients' faith and spiritual beliefs as a core part of our team's care.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured pace. Weight on 'respect' — this is policy, not afterthought. Professional warmth. No condescension. The voice of someone who has seen why this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 女系遺伝病の家系図を、貴院、分析されますね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, your hospital does analyze family histories for hereditary conditions, doesn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Testing whether he's read the situation correctly. Genuine curiosity mixed with polite deference. Pause before 'doesn't it' — leaving room for her response.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、震度別の医療体制を医療チームで訓練します
lines.en: Yes — we train our medical team in disaster response protocols scaled by seismic intensity.
lines.style: Direct, informative delivery. No flourish. Facts stated with clarity. Patient but efficient. The tone of someone explaining what is already standard practice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、上半身のリハビリを医療チームで指導します
lines.en: Yes — we provide upper-body rehabilitation guidance coordinated through our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, competent affirmation. Clinical specificity without coldness. Slight emphasis on 'upper-body' — precision matters. Warm professional tone, not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学界の巨匠を、貴院、お招きされてますね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, your hospital does invite distinguished figures from the medical field, doesn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, observant question. Soft respect in the phrasing. Not challenging — genuinely interested. Pause at the end, creating space for her to elaborate if she wants to.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療系社団法人と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Yes — we collaborate with medical professional associations and integrate them into our team's work.
lines.style: Warm closing affirmation. Slightly softer than prior 'Yes' statements — conversational ease. Professional but human. Close, like an understanding between two people who see the full picture.
